parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas and primary card surfaces — the warm beige that carries the entire interface

linen.$description: Linen — Secondary surface tone for elevated sections and subtle layering above parchment

warm-stone.$description: Warm Stone — Hairline borders and 1px section dividers throughout the interface

walnut.$description: Walnut — Muted helper text, captions, and de-emphasized metadata

espresso.$description: Espresso — Secondary body text and subhead copy — warm dark gray that softens pure black

onyx-warm.$description: Onyx Warm — Primary text, navigation, headings, and dark surface fills

midnight-roast.$description: Midnight Roast — Deepest dark surface for photo overlays and high-contrast hero backgrounds

saffron-glow.$description: Saffron Glow — Sole chromatic accent — featured tags, active states, decorative punctuation; warm spice-orange against the beige canvas creates curated restraint

tt-ramillas-variable.$description: All display and section headings — set uppercase at extreme sizes with weight 300; the whisper-weight serif at 115px is the signature anti-convention choice, creating editorial luxury through restraint rather than bold volume

satoshi.$description: Navigation, buttons, body copy, labels, and the 199px hero wordmark — confident 500-weight geometric sans provides structural counterpoint to the airy serif
